name: Xenos, Forbidden and Black-Market Gear
summary: Availability and provenance are separate. A Rare Imperial power sword and a Rare Aeldari weapon may share the same acquisition difficulty but carry very different legal, technical and political consequences. Xenos or proscribed equipment may require a specific contact, training, modification or narrative permission even when a Requisition test succeeds.
